acceptance: With explicit live-cloud approval, run a small TPC-H DataFrame power run on Databricks with --capture-plans; plans and fingerprints attach to measured rows and no explain call happens inside timed windows.
The mixed frame/SQL-key path captures or records a failure for every key.
If after-the-fact explain is not possible remotely, change the capability honestly and document it.
context:
Blocked: requires explicit live-cloud approval and Databricks credentials (AGENTS.md: live cloud tests require explicit approval). Not authorized in the batch request. Unblock when the owner approves a bounded run.

Verification rubric: (1) a regression test or reproduction fails before and passes after; (2) focused suites pass via uv run -- python -m pytest -n 0; (3) make comment-policy-check and ruff on touched files pass; (4) the runtime smoke named in acceptance is recorded in the PR body; (5) the PR merges with green CI and a passing oracle review.
description: PR #3711 moved Databricks DataFrame plan capture out of the measured windows: frames are recorded during measurement, explained in the post-measurement phase, and SQL-string keys are delegated to the base capture phase. All of this was tested with a fake Databricks Connect session only. Whether a collected remote DataFrame can still be explained after the workload, and what the round-trip costs, is unverified.
